message.jaymospowers.lens.empty: The lens finds no essence in %s.

message.jaymospowers.lens.lost: Your gaze wanders, and the lens clouds.

gui.jaymospowers.codex.hint: Pick an entry to read of it. Drag the page to move about it.
gui.jaymospowers.codex.hint_essences: The essences you have found, and what each is made of. Scry more things to find more.
research.jaymospowers.alchemy_basics.tex: All things are made of a few essences, mingled in measure. Hold the lens upon a thing, steady for a breath, and it will tell you a part of what it is. Each reading teaches you something, and what you learn is insight, which this book lets you spend.
research.jaymospowers.essences.text: Seven are plain, and from them the rest are made: two joined make a compound, and compounds joined make rarer things still. A compound cannot be read until you know the two that make it. The last page of this book keeps what you have found.
research.jaymospowers.scrying.text: Hold the lens on a creature or a block for a full breath, and do not let your gaze wander. With nothing in view it reads what you carry in your other hand. Stranger and rarer things teach more, but what you have read once will not teach you again.
